paragraphs.text: Ruhan of the Fomori , is a legendary giant warrior from the plane of Ir .

Born blind, the horned giant Ruhan chose a life of war. He was trained by the famed swordmasters of the Fomori race, but his weapon of choice is a deadly great mace. Even if his elders have alliances, his only allegiance is to none but his whim. Ruhan defies every rule, every expectation, and every structure meant to hold him.
He speaks of himself in the third person.
